response: The EQ-5D is a valid instrument for assessing quality of life in patients with acute coronary syndrome. According to studies, the Turkish version of the EQ-5D-based utility score has been found to be a valid tool in evaluating quality of life in these patients. This suggests that the EQ-5D can be effectively used to measure and assess the quality of life in individuals with acute coronary syndrome, providing valuable insights for healthcare providers and researchers.
